description: This file defines API endpoints for managing tasks, including CRUD operations such as listing, creating, updating, and deleting tasks for authenticated users. It uses FastAPI for routing and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Database model representing a task, associated with the current user as the owner.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, used for authentication and ownership verification.

methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of tasks filtered by optional query parameters (search string and completion status).

methods.description: Endpoint to update details of a specific task belonging to the current user.
